A JSON backlog, not prose: workareas/shared/design-release-2-1/sources/dr1-parity-union/backlog.json (31,988 lines), the Design Release 1 parity backlog of run EUDPA-328-DR1U (target live-animals-frontend, corpus dr1u), copied from commit 6688fd8e on origin/feat/parity-report-triage-view. Top level: run_id, target, corpus and increments[], an array of 161 rows (inc-001 to inc-161, not in id order; the file runs roughly by domain: service-wide, dashboard, origin, commodities, identification, addresses, import-reason, hub, documents, transport, contact, address-book, review, then a tail of hub/dashboard/dropped rows). Each row is one difference between the real animals frontend and the DR1 prototype, with fields id, title, status, domain, slice, band, type, confidence, finding {frontend, prototype, difference, correction, falsifiedBy, relatedTo}, detail (the finding restated as prose), evidence, screens, citations, controls, dependsOn, provenance {sourceA, sourceC, origin, note, better, judged} (how two discovery runs were matched), commit, branch, ticket, prs, gate (always null), milestone (always null), failure_reason, and on some rows decision {ruling, note} (44 rows), notes (4 rows), openQuestions (17 rows) and repo (4 rows). Statuses: 118 done, 34 blocked, 5 dropped, 3 deferred, 1 rejected. Each row is about 120 to 300 lines; inc-161 is 865. The scope takes in only DR1's judgements, so the parts cover the 64 rows that carry one: every row whose status is blocked, dropped, deferred or rejected (43 rows, each with a decision giving the reason), and every done row with a non-null decision, notes, openQuestions or failure_reason (21 rows: inc-003, 004, 006, 007, 033, 067, 069, 079, 082, 087, 091, 118, 122, 136, 137, 138, 146, 147, 150, 153, 161). Left out: the 97 done rows with none of those fields, whose finding.difference is a built proposal rather than a judgement (inc-051's finding argues for keeping the frontend's nine-digit CPH check, but in finding rather than notes, so it stays out); and on in-scope rows, provenance notes about how runs A and C were matched, PR and commit bookkeeping, evidence and screens, which the part agents read for context but do not claim as judgements. The parts are cut along the backlog's own domain seams, each row read in full by its line range.

Extracted in 8 parts:
Part 1, Service-wide rows: Part 1, Service-wide rows. Read the backlog's top level (run_id EUDPA-328-DR1U, target live-animals-frontend, corpus dr1u, 161 increments) and six service-wide rows in full by line range: inc-003 phase banner (lines 4-155, done, notes with CORRECTION 1-2, a RULING on the feedback link, VERIFIED BEFORE BUILD, NOT AVAILABLE, BLAST RADIUS, RELATED; one openQuestion), inc-004 section caption above headings (156-338, done, one openQuestion on caption placement), inc-007 service navigation items (507-676, done, three openQuestions: tests-repo auth specs, visual baseline, orphaned view-context fields), inc-161 what a page offers at its foot (4240-5105, done, decision accept: rule (b), with the verifier's notes on which pages keep the controls), inc-006 save and cancel controls (7174-7344, done, two dated notes) and inc-013 save-and-return button and cancel link on five pages (31606-31729, dropped, decision reject). Claims cover every RULING, decision, note and open question in those rows, plus what each done row settled where the row's own difference states a choice the later DR2.1 work must weigh (banner copy, caption set and exclusions, navigation items and hrefs, the hub-to-overview rename, the rule (b) page list, which pages keep the controls, and the mechanism). Provenance notes, PR and commit bookkeeping, evidence, screens and the verifier's count corrections were read for context and not claimed, except where a provenance note records the ruling itself.
Part 2, Dashboard list, filters, search and sort: Part 2, Dashboard list, filters, search and sort. Read in full, by line range in backlog.json, the eight dashboard rows inc-017 (lines 677-837, date filter), inc-018 (838-962, three collapsed filter sections), inc-019 (963-1177, three-term search), inc-020 (1178-1382, status filter), inc-021 (2142-2285, list heading "My notifications"), inc-022 (2286-2447, results count copy), inc-024 (2779-2915, sort applies only on submit / "Update sort" button) and inc-023 (2916-3095, sort option labels). Every one has status "blocked". Six (inc-017 to inc-022) carry decision {ruling: "block"} with one identical note: blocked by Rhys on 2026-08-28 because the dashboard is temporary in the animals frontend and moves to trade-imports-ins-frontend; deferred, not rejected, needing a fresh ruling if the dashboard stays. Two (inc-023, inc-024) carry decision {ruling: "defer", ruledAt} by Sam on 2026-08-21: the dashboard is temporary, so no sort work for now. None of the eight has notes, openQuestions or a failure_reason. For each row the claims record the ruling, who made it and when, the reason, any reopening condition, and the difference the ruling parks (from finding.difference), plus the judgements the row itself makes inside finding.difference, finding.correction and provenance.note (band chosen between runs A and C, conditions that must be settled before building, what DR1 leaves unsaid). Provenance notes about run matching, citations, evidence and screens were read for context only.
Part 3, Dashboard cards, summary and actions: Part 3, Dashboard cards, summary and actions. Read in full the eleven dashboard rows of backlog.json increments[] by their line ranges: inc-014 (1383-1564), inc-015 (1842-2003), inc-016 (2004-2141), inc-002 (2448-2646), inc-025 (2647-2778), inc-026 (27772-27986), inc-030 (30774-30905), inc-031 (30906-31196), inc-027 (31197-31328), inc-028 (31329-31472) and inc-029 (31473-31605). Each row carries title, detail, finding {frontend, prototype, difference, correction or verification, falsifiedBy, relatedTo}, citations, controls, provenance and a decision. Nine rows are status blocked with decision.ruling "block" and an identical decision.note (Rhys, 2026-08-28: the dashboard is temporary in the animals frontend and moves to trade-imports-ins-frontend); two (inc-030, inc-031) are status dropped with decision.ruling "reject" by Sam on 2026-08-21 and a ruledAt timestamp. Claims cover, for every row, the ruling, who ruled and when, and the reason; then the difference each row judged, its band, and any open question or rule the row states. Provenance notes on how runs A and C were matched, citations and screens were read for context and not claimed as judgements.
Part 4, Origin, reason for import and hub: Part 4, Origin, reason for import and hub. Read in full, by line range in backlog.json, the eight in-scope rows of this slice: inc-079 (3096-3376, origin, done, region of origin code prefix), inc-067 (9817-10221, import-reason, done, purpose and exit questions as conditional reveals), inc-069 (10417-10643, hub, done, Exit details task), inc-081 (10644-10788, origin, blocked, Canary Islands / Jersey / French Guiana in the country list), inc-082 (10789-10933, origin, done, origin page refuses to save), inc-071 (12632-12915, import-reason, blocked, port of exit list), inc-033 (28474-28610, hub, done, Commodity details task row) and inc-043 (30082-30186, hub, rejected, 'Notification tasklist' heading). Each row carries title, detail, finding {frontend, prototype, difference, correction, falsifiedBy, relatedTo}, citations, provenance and PRs; the judgement fields are openQuestions (inc-079: 1, inc-067: 3, inc-033: 1), notes (inc-067: two failed attempts, inc-043: falsified attempt), failure_reason (inc-069, inc-082: both cleared false main-red stops) and decision (inc-081, inc-071: block on MDM; inc-043: falsified). Claims record, per row, what DR1 judged (built, blocked, rejected), then every deferral, open question, action and reason in those judgement fields; where a done row's finding also leaves a point to settle (inc-079's reference-data route) or a blocked row leaves its finding's question open (inc-081's EFTA states, inc-071's V4 spec conflict), that is recorded as a gap. Provenance matching notes, citations, evidence, screens and PR bookkeeping were read for context and not claimed.
Part 5, Commodities, identification and documents: Part 5, Commodities, identification and documents. Read in full the seven backlog.json rows in this slice by their line ranges: inc-087 (5106-5312, commodity search, done, one openQuestion on the search hint wording), inc-091 (6112-6386, per-species rows for 01061900, done, one openQuestion on the commodity stub, plus the run A versus run C banding judgement in finding.difference and provenance.judged), inc-103 (8456-8666, an animal counts as identified once one identifier is filled, deferred, decision by Rhys 2026-09-04), inc-136 (14669-15088, document type select, done, one openQuestion on the error-summary ordering helper, plus a correction saying the builder should take DR1's option text), inc-137 (15089-15219, drag and drop upload, done, two openQuestions: second-submit error clearing and the no-JavaScript fallback), inc-138 (15525-15708, 50MB document size limit, done, two openQuestions: the CDP ingress cap blocking deploy and container memory headroom) and inc-094 (30484-30633, lowering the number of animals below those identified, dropped, decision by Sam 2026-08-21). Each done row gets one context claim saying what landed, then a claim per decision, departure from the prototype and open question; each deferred or dropped row gets its ruling, its reason and the behaviour on each side it rules between. Evidence, screens, citations, PR bookkeeping and run-matching provenance were read for context and not claimed, except inc-091's band choice, which the row itself calls the decision with money attached.
Part 6, Addresses: permanent address, parties and pickers: Part 6 read eight rows of backlog.json increments[] in full, in file order: inc-058 (lines 8133-8311), inc-057 (8839-9095), inc-056 (17244-17454), inc-052 (17455-17632), inc-045 (17633-17843), inc-063 (18068-18418), inc-047 (22182-22404) and inc-048 (22405-22665). Every row has status "blocked" and decision.ruling "block"; none carries notes, openQuestions or failure_reason. Rows inc-058, inc-057, inc-056, inc-052, inc-045 and inc-063 (domain addresses) were blocked by Rhys on 2026-09-04 because live address work in the consignment party space would collide; inc-047 (domain contact) and inc-048 (domain addresses), both banded needs-backend, were blocked by Rhys on 2026-08-28 pending a typed address-book record that travels with the address book to trade-imports-ins-frontend, a note that also calls them deferred. Each row is laid out as id, type, domain, title, detail (frontend, prototype, difference and FALSIFIED BY paragraphs), screens, evidence, band, status, finding (frontend, prototype, difference, correction, falsifiedBy, verification, sometimes relatedTo), citations, controls, provenance (sourceA/sourceC, note, better) and decision (ruling, note). Claims record, per row: the ruling, who and when, the reason in decision.note; the difference DR1 judged (what Design release 1 does that the frontend does not, and the change the row prescribes); the corrections, constraints and related-row links its finding records. Citations, screens, evidence and the run-matching provenance notes were read for context and not claimed. Within scope the source is a DR1 judgement record, so claims state what the row records, not requirements of their own.
Part 7, Address book and address picker: Part 7, Address book and address picker. Read in full seven increments[] rows of backlog.json: inc-053 (lines 22666-22879, flow-change, address-book: no route to add an address from a picker or the contact page), inc-065 (22880-23062, copy-change, addresses: list heading and count wording), inc-046 (23063-23221, copy-change, addresses: contact-address page guidance), inc-064 (26713-26980, add-section, addresses: picker table width), inc-054 (26981-27170, flow-change, address-book: no route to correct a saved address from a picker), inc-055 (27171-27496, flow-change, addresses: whole book on one page, filtered as you type) and inc-062 (30187-30483, add-page, address-book: the saved address book pages, status dropped). Each row carries title, detail, finding.{frontend, prototype, difference, correction, falsifiedBy, verification, relatedTo}, citations, provenance.note and decision. The six blocked rows share one decision: ruling block, by Rhys, 2026-09-04, because address work is live in that space. inc-062 carries decision ruling reject, by Sam, 2026-08-21, ruledAt 2026-08-21T05:57:03Z. Claims record each ruling, who and when, its reason, and the judgements each row records in its difference, correction and provenance notes (bands chosen, sequencing, what survives a ruling, design calls left open), plus the Design release 1 behaviour and copy each row judges against the frontend.
Part 8, Transport and review: Part 8 of 8, Transport and review. Read in full nine rows of backlog.json increments[] by their line ranges: inc-118 (transit countries type-ahead, done, EUDPA-545, one openQuestion), inc-122 (transporter list as a table with Type and Status, done, EUDPA-562, one openQuestion), inc-126 (duplicate port names, deferred, band disputed, decision ruling defer by Rhys 2026-09-04), inc-127 (malformed port names, blocked, band needs-backend, decision ruling block by Rhys 2026-09-07), inc-150 (incomplete-notification signal on Check your answers, done, EUDPA-580, two openQuestions), inc-146 (Change links per card not per row, done, EUDPA-581, one openQuestion), inc-147 (six numbered review sections, done, EUDPA-583, one openQuestion), inc-145 (arrival date label on review, deferred, band disputed, decision ruling defer by Rhys 2026-09-04) and inc-153 (what is still outstanding after submit, done, EUDPA-589, one openQuestion). Each row carries title, detail, finding {frontend, prototype, difference, correction, falsifiedBy, verification, relatedTo}, citations, controls, provenance, PRs, and either decision {ruling, note, ruledAt} (the three deferred or blocked rows) or openQuestions (the six done rows). Claims cover: for each done row, one or two claims recording what landed (so the reconciler knows the built baseline), then every decision, departure from DR1 and open question in its openQuestions, with the open decisions recorded as gap claims quoting the question; for each deferred or blocked row, the ruling, who made it and when, its reason, the condition for revisiting, and the substance the ruling holds open. Provenance notes on how runs A and C were matched, PR bookkeeping, evidence and screens were read for context and not claimed.
